name: Yatsushiro Yuzuriha
source:
Eccentric and dynamic. Because of her way of speaking and the randomness of the things she says, she is thought to be strange, but that is her world. 
She is thought to be egotistic, but perhaps because she is the president of organizations, she is good at looking out for and taking care of others. 
Though her words and actions are theatrical, her position as the president of the Council of Nicaea gives her a kind of dignity. 
She is well trusted by all students at the academy. She is childhood friends with [url=/c16867]Nerine Komikado[/url], the vice president of the Council of Nicaea, whom she calls Neri. 
Although she belongs to the cooking club, she is terrible at cooking.
Her interests are sports and photography.

[From [url=http://flowersgame.com/]Jast USA[/url]]
